audit_logs_json_shape_check.name: audit_logs_json_shape_check
audit_logs_json_shape_check.value:
("audit_logs"."before_data" is null or jsonb_typeof("audit_logs"."before_data") = 'object')
        and ("audit_logs"."after_data" is null or jsonb_typeof("audit_logs"."after_data") = 'object')
        and jsonb_typeof("audit_logs"."metadata") = 'object'

carts_exactly_one_owner_check.name: carts_exactly_one_owner_check
carts_exactly_one_owner_check.value:
("carts"."user_id" is not null and "carts"."guest_token_hash" is null)
        or ("carts"."user_id" is null and "carts"."guest_token_hash" is not null)

carts_guest_requires_expiry_check.name: carts_guest_requires_expiry_check
carts_guest_requires_expiry_check.value: "carts"."guest_token_hash" is null or "carts"."expires_at" is not null

carts_merged_target_check.name: carts_merged_target_check
carts_merged_target_check.value:
("carts"."status" = 'MERGED' and "carts"."merged_into_cart_id" is not null)
        or ("carts"."status" <> 'MERGED' and "carts"."merged_into_cart_id" is null)

carts_converted_at_check.name: carts_converted_at_check
carts_converted_at_check.value:
("carts"."status" = 'CONVERTED' and "carts"."converted_at" is not null)
        or ("carts"."status" <> 'CONVERTED' and "carts"."converted_at" is null)

collections_valid_window_check.name: collections_valid_window_check
collections_valid_window_check.value: "collections"."starts_at" is null or "collections"."ends_at" is null or "collections"."ends_at" > "collections"."starts_at"

product_images_lifecycle_check.name: product_images_lifecycle_check
product_images_lifecycle_check.value:
(
          "product_images"."status" = 'PENDING'
          and "product_images"."confirmed_at" is null
          and "product_images"."is_primary" = false
        )
        or (
          "product_images"."status" = 'CONFIRMED'
          and "product_images"."confirmed_at" is not null
        )

products_storefront_brand_published_idx.name: products_storefront_brand_published_idx
products_storefront_brand_published_idx.where: "products"."status" = 'ACTIVE' and "products"."deleted_at" is null and "products"."brand_id" is not null

addresses_required_text_check.name: addresses_required_text_check
addresses_required_text_check.value:
length(btrim("addresses"."label")) > 0
        and length(btrim("addresses"."recipient_name")) > 0
        and length(btrim("addresses"."phone")) > 0
        and length(btrim("addresses"."address_line_1")) > 0
        and length(btrim("addresses"."city")) > 0
        and length(btrim("addresses"."province")) > 0
        and length(btrim("addresses"."postal_code")) > 0

auth_action_tokens_terminal_state_check.name: auth_action_tokens_terminal_state_check
auth_action_tokens_terminal_state_check.value: not ("auth_action_tokens"."consumed_at" is not null and "auth_action_tokens"."revoked_at" is not null)

auth_refresh_tokens_revocation_check.name: auth_refresh_tokens_revocation_check
auth_refresh_tokens_revocation_check.value:
("auth_refresh_tokens"."revoked_at" is null and "auth_refresh_tokens"."revoke_reason" is null)
        or (
          "auth_refresh_tokens"."revoked_at" is not null
          and "auth_refresh_tokens"."revoke_reason" is not null
          and length(btrim("auth_refresh_tokens"."revoke_reason")) > 0
        )

auth_refresh_tokens_reuse_check.name: auth_refresh_tokens_reuse_check
auth_refresh_tokens_reuse_check.value: "auth_refresh_tokens"."reuse_detected_at" is null or "auth_refresh_tokens"."used_at" is not null

auth_sessions_revocation_check.name: auth_sessions_revocation_check
auth_sessions_revocation_check.value:
("auth_sessions"."revoked_at" is null and "auth_sessions"."revoke_reason" is null)
        or (
          "auth_sessions"."revoked_at" is not null
          and "auth_sessions"."revoke_reason" is not null
          and length(btrim("auth_sessions"."revoke_reason")) > 0
        )

inventory_movements_reference_pair_check.name: inventory_movements_reference_pair_check
inventory_movements_reference_pair_check.value:
("inventory_movements"."reference_type" is null and "inventory_movements"."reference_id" is null)
        or ("inventory_movements"."reference_type" is not null and "inventory_movements"."reference_id" is not null)

inventory_reservations_status_fields_che.name: inventory_reservations_status_fields_check
inventory_reservations_status_fields_che.value:
(
          "inventory_reservations"."status" = 'ACTIVE'
          and "inventory_reservations"."merchant_order_id" is null
          and "inventory_reservations"."converted_at" is null
          and "inventory_reservations"."released_at" is null
        )
        or (
          "inventory_reservations"."status" = 'CONVERTED'
          and "inventory_reservations"."merchant_order_id" is not null
          and "inventory_reservations"."converted_at" is not null
          and "inventory_reservations"."released_at" is null
        )
        or (
          "inventory_reservations"."status" in ('RELEASED', 'EXPIRED')
          and "inventory_reservations"."converted_at" is null
          and "inventory_reservations"."released_at" is not null
        )

merchant_invitations_acceptance_check.name: merchant_invitations_acceptance_check
merchant_invitations_acceptance_check.value:
(
          "merchant_invitations"."status" = 'ACCEPTED'
          and "merchant_invitations"."accepted_at" is not null
          and "merchant_invitations"."accepted_by_membership_id" is not null
        )
        or (
          "merchant_invitations"."status" <> 'ACCEPTED'
          and "merchant_invitations"."accepted_at" is null
          and "merchant_invitations"."accepted_by_membership_id" is null
        )

merchant_invitations_revocation_check.name: merchant_invitations_revocation_check
merchant_invitations_revocation_check.value:
("merchant_invitations"."status" = 'REVOKED' and "merchant_invitations"."revoked_at" is not null)
        or ("merchant_invitations"."status" <> 'REVOKED' and "merchant_invitations"."revoked_at" is null)

merchant_verifications_review_fields_che.name: merchant_verifications_review_fields_check
merchant_verifications_review_fields_che.value:
(
          (
            "merchant_verifications"."status" in ('VERIFIED', 'REJECTED')
            or "merchant_verifications"."status"::text = 'CHANGES_REQUESTED'
          )
          and "merchant_verifications"."reviewed_at" is not null
          and "merchant_verifications"."reviewed_by_user_id" is not null
        )
        or "merchant_verifications"."status" in ('UNVERIFIED', 'PENDING')

merchants_applicant_open_application_uni.name: merchants_applicant_open_application_unique
merchants_applicant_open_application_uni.where:
"merchants"."created_by_user_id" is not null
          and "merchants"."deleted_at" is null
          and "merchants"."status" = 'PENDING'
          and "merchants"."verification_status" not in ('VERIFIED', 'REJECTED')

merchants_applicant_created_at_idx.name: merchants_applicant_created_at_idx
merchants_applicant_created_at_idx.where: "merchants"."created_by_user_id" is not null and "merchants"."deleted_at" is null

fulfillments_tracking_unique.name: fulfillments_tracking_unique
fulfillments_tracking_unique.where: "fulfillments"."carrier" is not null and "fulfillments"."tracking_number" is not null

fulfillments_shipped_at_check.name: fulfillments_shipped_at_check
fulfillments_shipped_at_check.value:
"fulfillments"."status" not in ('SHIPPED', 'DELIVERED')
        or "fulfillments"."shipped_at" is not null

fulfillments_delivery_order_check.name: fulfillments_delivery_order_check
fulfillments_delivery_order_check.value:
"fulfillments"."delivered_at" is null
        or ("fulfillments"."shipped_at" is not null and "fulfillments"."delivered_at" >= "fulfillments"."shipped_at")

merchant_orders_nonnegative_amounts_chec.name: merchant_orders_nonnegative_amounts_check
merchant_orders_nonnegative_amounts_chec.value:
"merchant_orders"."items_subtotal_centavos" >= 0
        and "merchant_orders"."discount_centavos" >= 0
        and "merchant_orders"."shipping_centavos" >= 0
        and "merchant_orders"."tax_centavos" >= 0
        and "merchant_orders"."gross_total_centavos" >= 0
        and "merchant_orders"."platform_commission_centavos" >= 0
        and "merchant_orders"."merchant_earnings_centavos" >= 0
        and "merchant_orders"."refunded_centavos" >= 0
        and "merchant_orders"."commission_reversed_centavos" >= 0
        and "merchant_orders"."merchant_refund_liability_centavos" >= 0
        and "merchant_orders"."net_merchant_earnings_centavos" >= 0

merchant_orders_cancelled_at_check.name: merchant_orders_cancelled_at_check
merchant_orders_cancelled_at_check.value:
("merchant_orders"."status" = 'CANCELLED' and "merchant_orders"."cancelled_at" is not null)
        or ("merchant_orders"."status" <> 'CANCELLED' and "merchant_orders"."cancelled_at" is null)

order_addresses_required_text_check.name: order_addresses_required_text_check
order_addresses_required_text_check.value:
length(btrim("order_addresses"."recipient_name")) > 0
        and length(btrim("order_addresses"."phone")) > 0
        and length(btrim("order_addresses"."address_line_1")) > 0
        and length(btrim("order_addresses"."city")) > 0
        and length(btrim("order_addresses"."province")) > 0
        and length(btrim("order_addresses"."postal_code")) > 0

order_items_nonnegative_amounts_check.name: order_items_nonnegative_amounts_check
order_items_nonnegative_amounts_check.value:
"order_items"."unit_price_centavos" >= 0
        and "order_items"."line_subtotal_centavos" >= 0
        and "order_items"."line_discount_centavos" >= 0
        and "order_items"."line_tax_centavos" >= 0
        and "order_items"."line_total_centavos" >= 0
        and "order_items"."platform_commission_centavos" >= 0
        and "order_items"."merchant_earnings_centavos" >= 0

orders_cancelled_at_check.name: orders_cancelled_at_check
orders_cancelled_at_check.value:
("orders"."status" = 'CANCELLED' and "orders"."cancelled_at" is not null)
        or ("orders"."status" <> 'CANCELLED' and "orders"."cancelled_at" is null)

merchant_payouts_provider_reference_uniq.name: merchant_payouts_provider_reference_unique
merchant_payouts_provider_reference_uniq.where: "merchant_payouts"."provider" is not null and "merchant_payouts"."provider_payout_id" is not null

merchant_payouts_period_check.name: merchant_payouts_period_check
merchant_payouts_period_check.value:
"merchant_payouts"."period_starts_at" is null
        or "merchant_payouts"."period_ends_at" is null
        or "merchant_payouts"."period_ends_at" > "merchant_payouts"."period_starts_at"

merchant_payouts_provider_reference_pair.name: merchant_payouts_provider_reference_pair_check
merchant_payouts_provider_reference_pair.value:
("merchant_payouts"."provider" is null and "merchant_payouts"."provider_payout_id" is null)
        or (
          "merchant_payouts"."provider" is not null
          and length(btrim("merchant_payouts"."provider")) > 0
          and "merchant_payouts"."provider_payout_id" is not null
          and length(btrim("merchant_payouts"."provider_payout_id")) > 0
        )

payments_provider_payment_unique.name: payments_provider_payment_unique
payments_provider_payment_unique.where: "payments"."provider" is not null and "payments"."provider_payment_id" is not null

payments_paid_at_check.name: payments_paid_at_check
payments_paid_at_check.value:
"payments"."status" not in ('PAID', 'PARTIALLY_REFUNDED', 'REFUNDED')
        or "payments"."paid_at" is not null

payments_online_provider_check.name: payments_online_provider_check
payments_online_provider_check.value:
"payments"."method" <> 'ONLINE_PAYMENT'
        or "payments"."status" not in ('AUTHORIZED', 'PAID', 'PARTIALLY_REFUNDED', 'REFUNDED')
        or ("payments"."provider" is not null and "payments"."provider_payment_id" is not null)

payments_provider_reference_pair_check.name: payments_provider_reference_pair_check
payments_provider_reference_pair_check.value:
("payments"."provider" is null and "payments"."provider_payment_id" is null)
        or (
          "payments"."provider" is not null
          and length(btrim("payments"."provider")) > 0
          and "payments"."provider_payment_id" is not null
          and length(btrim("payments"."provider_payment_id")) > 0
        )

discount_redemptions_reversed_at_check.name: discount_redemptions_reversed_at_check
discount_redemptions_reversed_at_check.value:
("discount_redemptions"."status" = 'REVERSED' and "discount_redemptions"."reversed_at" is not null)
        or ("discount_redemptions"."status" <> 'REVERSED' and "discount_redemptions"."reversed_at" is null)

discounts_code_method_check.name: discounts_code_method_check
discounts_code_method_check.value:
(
          "discounts"."application_method" = 'CODE'
          and "discounts"."code" is not null
          and "discounts"."code" = upper(btrim("discounts"."code"))
          and length("discounts"."code") > 0
        )
        or (
          "discounts"."application_method" = 'AUTOMATIC'
          and "discounts"."code" is null
        )

discounts_value_shape_check.name: discounts_value_shape_check
discounts_value_shape_check.value:
(
          "discounts"."discount_type" = 'FIXED_AMOUNT'
          and "discounts"."fixed_amount_centavos" > 0
          and "discounts"."percentage_basis_points" is null
          and "discounts"."maximum_discount_centavos" is null
        )
        or (
          "discounts"."discount_type" = 'PERCENTAGE'
          and "discounts"."fixed_amount_centavos" is null
          and "discounts"."percentage_basis_points" between 1 and 10000
        )
        or (
          "discounts"."discount_type" = 'FREE_SHIPPING'
          and "discounts"."fixed_amount_centavos" is null
          and "discounts"."percentage_basis_points" is null
        )

discounts_nonnegative_thresholds_check.name: discounts_nonnegative_thresholds_check
discounts_nonnegative_thresholds_check.value:
"discounts"."minimum_subtotal_centavos" >= 0
        and "discounts"."minimum_item_quantity" >= 1
        and "discounts"."redeemed_count" >= 0
        and (
          "discounts"."maximum_discount_centavos" is null
          or "discounts"."maximum_discount_centavos" >= 0
        )

discounts_positive_usage_limits_check.name: discounts_positive_usage_limits_check
discounts_positive_usage_limits_check.value:
("discounts"."total_usage_limit" is null or "discounts"."total_usage_limit" > 0)
        and ("discounts"."per_user_usage_limit" is null or "discounts"."per_user_usage_limit" > 0)

outbox_messages_processing_lock_check.name: outbox_messages_processing_lock_check
outbox_messages_processing_lock_check.value:
"outbox_messages"."status" <> 'PROCESSING'
        or (
          "outbox_messages"."locked_at" is not null
          and "outbox_messages"."locked_by" is not null
          and length(btrim("outbox_messages"."locked_by")) > 0
        )

outbox_messages_processed_at_check.name: outbox_messages_processed_at_check
outbox_messages_processed_at_check.value:
("outbox_messages"."status" in ('PROCESSED', 'FAILED') and "outbox_messages"."processed_at" is not null)
        or ("outbox_messages"."status" not in ('PROCESSED', 'FAILED') and "outbox_messages"."processed_at" is null)

reviews_published_at_check.name: reviews_published_at_check
reviews_published_at_check.value:
("reviews"."status" = 'PUBLISHED' and "reviews"."published_at" is not null)
        or ("reviews"."status" <> 'PUBLISHED' and "reviews"."published_at" is null)
